Anna K: Postmortem follow-up: splitting remediation into ownership tasks and a micro-runbook. Need owners/ETAs.

Ben M: I'll take eviction correlation. ETA 2026-04-08.

Carlos R: I'll run autoscaler repro + tuning. Canary Wed. ETA 2026-04-01.

Lucy W: I'll edit the playbook: inline triage, paging flow, and escalation TTL. Target 2026-03-30.

Tina (oncall): Please include a 3-command micro-runbook in the page. Oncall needs actionable steps in the page body.

sre-bot: Tasks created: TASK-3701, TASK-3702, TASK-3703.

Anna K: Micro-runbook draft to embed:

```
# micro-triage
redwoodctl svc ps inference
redwoodctl logs inference/<pod> --last 200 | grep -Ei "evict|OOM|cache"
promql "rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])" | jq .
# if eviction spikes -> /sherlock page infra-sre "eviction + latency spike -> TASK-3701"
```

Anna K: Action list:
- TASK-3701: KV eviction correlation — owner Ben M — ETA 2026-04-08
- TASK-3702: Autoscaler repro & tuning — owner Carlos R — ETA 2026-04-01
- TASK-3703: Playbook micro-delta & escalation TTL — owner Lucy W — ETA 2026-03-30
- TASK-3704: Two-week recurrence watch (weekly) — owner Tina (oncall) — start 2026-03-31

Ben M: I'll add grep markers + expected log snippets to TASK-3701.

Carlos R: Will attach canary job config (ns: repro-load) and a small failmap.

Lucy W: Will mark TASK-3703 high-priority and open PR to docs, ping @docs-reviewers.

Tina (oncall): Subscribed to tasks; will run first recurrence check next Tue. Please add symptom blurb to tasks: "sustained latency + 5xx increase + eviction logs".

sre-bot: TASK-3701 assigned to Ben M; TASK-3703 priority=high.

Anna K: Let's sync Mon 09:30 for a quick status check. Update tasks and this thread if anything slips. Thx :thumbsup:
